panels.title: Switches reporting (of 6)
panels.description: Switches currently streaming gNMI telemetry. Below 6: gNMI is off, the switch is down, or gnmic lost its subscription.

panels.title: Cabled ports up
panels.description: Ethernet ports that have a description (cabled in the lab) and are up.

panels.title: Cabled ports down
panels.description: Described Ethernet ports whose link is down. Undescribed spare ports are ignored (on EOS they are admin-up by default).

panels.title: Port traffic in
panels.description: Sum of ingress on all Ethernet ports. Each fabric link is counted at both ends.

panels.title: Port traffic out
panels.description: Sum of egress on all Ethernet ports.

panels.title: Errors + discards
panels.description: Errors and discards per second, all Ethernet ports.

panels.title: Sessions established
panels.description: BGP sessions in state ESTABLISHED across the selected switches: underlay eBGP plus the EVPN overlay peerings.

panels.title: Sessions NOT established
panels.description: Configured sessions in any other state (IDLE, CONNECT, ACTIVE, OPENSENT...).

panels.title: Session resets (1h)
panels.description: Sessions that (re)established in the last hour, i.e. dropped and came back.

panels.title: EVPN routes received by switch
panels.description: l2vpn-evpn prefixes received from all peers of each switch. A sudden drop means a VTEP or peering was lost.

panels.title: BGP peers
panels.description: One row per BGP session (all VRFs). Neighbor is the peer's IP; the underlay peers on 10.0.x.x, the EVPN overlay peers on loopbacks 10.255.0.x.

targets.expr: max by (source, network_instance_name, neighbor_neighbor_address) (gnmi_network_instances_network_instance_protocols_protocol_bgp_neighbors_neighbor_state_session_state{source=~"$switch",session_state="ESTABLISHED"}) or (max by (source, network_instance_name, neighbor_neighbor_address) (gnmi_network_instances_network_instance_protocols_protocol_bgp_neighbors_neighbor_state_session_state{source=~"$switch",session_state!="ESTABLISHED"}) * 0)

panels.title: Session state over time (UP / DOWN)
panels.description: One lane per session. Red = not established. Lane label: switch / VRF / neighbor IP.

targets.expr: max by (source, network_instance_name, neighbor_neighbor_address) (gnmi_network_instances_network_instance_protocols_protocol_bgp_neighbors_neighbor_state_session_state{source=~"$switch",session_state="ESTABLISHED"}) or (max by (source, network_instance_name, neighbor_neighbor_address) (gnmi_network_instances_network_instance_protocols_protocol_bgp_neighbors_neighbor_state_session_state{source=~"$switch",session_state!="ESTABLISHED"}) * 0)

panels.title: Ingress by switch
panels.description: Bits/s received on Ethernet ports, summed per switch.

panels.title: Egress by switch
panels.description: Bits/s sent on Ethernet ports, summed per switch.

panels.title: Top 10 interfaces (in + out)
panels.description: Busiest Ethernet ports over the selected range.

panels.title: Errors + discards by switch
panels.description: Should be flat at zero.

panels.title: CPU busy %
panels.description: 100 minus the instantaneous idle % the switch reports.

panels.title: Memory used %
panels.description: Used / physical memory (EOS-reported).

panels.title: Youngest BGP session (age)
panels.description: Age of the most recently established session on each switch; a small number means a recent flap.

panels.title: Cabled port state
panels.description: Operational state of every described Ethernet port (spare ports have no description and are not listed). DOWN on a cabled port is a fault.

targets.expr: (max by (source, interface_name) (gnmi_interfaces_interface_state_oper_status{source=~"$switch",interface_name=~"Ethernet[0-9]+",oper_status="UP"}) or (max by (source, interface_name) (gnmi_interfaces_interface_state_oper_status{source=~"$switch",interface_name=~"Ethernet[0-9]+",oper_status!="UP"}) * 0)) and on(source, interface_name) gnmi_interfaces_interface_state_description{source=~"$switch"}
